<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="330" y2="14" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="18" x2="336" y2="11" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="18" x2="342" y2="8" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="352" y1="14" x2="355" y2="17" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="364" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="366" y="11" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
  
  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="28,57 21,63 28,69" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="63" x2="38" y2="63" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="54" y="68" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Seat details</text>
  <circle cx="358" cy="57" r="10" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <circle cx="358" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#4658E0"/>
  <ellipse cx="358" cy="61" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#4658E0"/>
  
  <!-- Intro -->
  <text x="20" y="114" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Your assigned seats</text>
  <text x="20" y="137" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Review the seats assigned to each flight.</text>
  
  <!-- Tabs -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="154" width="170" height="48" rx="7" fill="#1B0188"/>
    <text x="105" y="174" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Outbound</text>
    <text x="105" y="191" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Cali → Bogotá</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="200" y="154" width="170" height="48" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="285" y="174" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Return</text>
    <text x="285" y="191" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Bogotá → Cali</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Information banner -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="218" width="350" height="78" rx="7" fill="#FFF9E6" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="243" r="10" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <text x="43" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="62" y="241" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Seats can't be changed</text>
    <text x="62" y="261" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">These seats were assigned automatically</text>
    <text x="62" y="278" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">and are not available for modification.</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Flight label -->
  <text x="20" y="326" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Cali to Bogotá</text>
  <text x="370" y="326" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Tue, 18 Jun · LA4052</text>
  
  <!-- Assigned seats card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="20" y="342" width="350" height="220" rx="7" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="339" width="350" height="220" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="40" y="370" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Assigned seats</text>
    <text x="40" y="391" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Economy · Airbus A320</text>
    <line x1="40" y1="407" x2="350" y2="407" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Passenger one -->
    <circle cx="59" cy="440" r="17" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="436" r="5" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <ellipse cx="59" cy="447" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <text x="87" y="438" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Mariana Torres</text>
    <text x="87" y="456" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Adult passenger</text>
    <circle cx="316" cy="440" r="19" fill="#1B0188"/>
    <text x="316" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">12A</text>
    
    <line x1="40" y1="475" x2="350" y2="475" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Passenger two -->
    <circle cx="59" cy="508" r="17" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="504" r="5" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <ellipse cx="59" cy="515" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <text x="87" y="506" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Daniel Torres</text>
    <text x="87" y="524" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Adult passenger</text>
    <circle cx="316" cy="508" r="19" fill="#1B0188"/>
    <text x="316" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">12B</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Seat legend / supporting detail -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="580" width="350" height="83" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="607" r="10" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <polyline points="40,607 44,611 51,603" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="64" y="608" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Seats confirmed</text>
    <text x="40" y="634" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Your boarding passes will show these seat</text>
    <text x="40" y="650" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">numbers when check-in opens.</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="682" width="350" height="48" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="712" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">View flight details</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,788 49,780 59,788" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="43" y="787" width="12" height="11" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="49" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="124" y="781" width="18" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="786" x2="138" y2="786" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="791" x2="138" y2="791" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="133" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="215" cy="789" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="215" y1="783" x2="215" y2="795" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="209" y1="789" x2="221" y2="789" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="215" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Manage</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="303" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="303" cy="797" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="303" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
